minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  February 14, 2018

A special meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, February
14, 2019, at 2:21 pm in the City Council Community Room A, 1st Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer – 2:21 p.m.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Serena Martinez, Finance Department

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Girl Scouts of Greater Los Angeles to host the Girl Scouts of Greater Los
  Angeles Inglewood Innovation Center Grand Opening at 423 N. La Brea
  Ave., February 24, 2019, from 1:00 pm – 4:00 pm, subject to Inglewood
  Police Department staffing (2 Officers); invoice for Police services to be
  paid five (5) days prior to your event date; vendor providing tents is required
  to contact the Los Angeles County Fire Department at (310) 263-2732;
  adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, including noise and signage.
  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 000273299)

  Present: Kenya M. Yarbrough, Representative, Girls Scouts of Greater
  Los Angeles

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  LAX Ammunition Los Angeles to conduct the LAX Ammo parking lot sale
  at 234 S. Hindry Ave., February 22-24, 2019 from 9:00 am – 5:00 pm,
  subject to event being contained exclusively to the location listed on this
  application; cannot obstruct or use public sidewalks, streets or alleys; sales
  of firearm ammunition to any persons without proper/legal government-
  issued identification is strictly prohibited; loitering inside/outside the
  business location is strictly prohibited; Possession or sales of any
  illegal/unauthorized firearms, ammunition, equipment or items deemed to
  be a hazard to public safety are strictly prohibited; all events are subject to
  random inspection by an police, fire or code enforcement officer or official
  at any time during hours of operation; business owner is required to
  possess all applicable local, county, state and/or federal licensing for sales
  of items; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; LAX Ammunition staff is to maintain
  and manage crowd control throughout the duration of the event; Security
  guards carrying firearms must be authorized and licensed with the Bureau
  of Security and Investigative Services; armed and/or unarmed security
  guards shall wear distinctive uniforms to be easily identified by the public;
  any person directing traffic is required to wear highly-visible retro-reflective
  vests; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; adhere

  to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage, local, state and federal laws. Motion carried
  unanimously. (Activity No. 00273814)

  Present: Vanessa Reyes, Representative, LAX Firing Range, Inc.

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:29 pm.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
